name: marccent/menu
title: Menu
description: A menu made in Appearance → Menus (or the one in the Primary location: the header's main menu), anywhere: a footer's links, a sidebar, the social links. Each link's icon is the Font Awesome classes in its CSS Classes field, else the site it goes to (Facebook, Instagram, Google…); links to other sites open in a new tab. It can fold behind a menu button where there’s no room (a header on a phone).
